experiments.scope: Exact grouped early abort evaluator (rounds to 30) on 16 groups of 32 consecutive y, 512 messages per trial, pair agreeing on the top 6 bits of each of digest words H1, H2, H3.
experiments.hypothesis: Grouped messages behave like independent uniform digests for pair counting, so a trial finds a pair with probability about 0.393.

experiments.scope: Same evaluator on one group of 512 consecutive y, pair agreeing on the top 18 bits of digest word H5.
experiments.hypothesis: Messages inside one group behave like independent uniform digests on an 18 bit slice of H5.
